title: fix(auth)!: a boot outside development mode retires what the development seed issued
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Nxmrq3P2eHj4WzMaPKLjA1)_

Fixes #35184

Supersedes #36311: this branch carries that PR's commits (head `c1e7347cc1`, merged onto current `main`) and adds one hardening commit. The card thread can push only its own branch, so the takeover lands here.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill states what a boot outside development mode does to a seeded account's credentials. `skills/**` names the development seed only as `os dev --seed-admin` (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`); checked at `origin/main`.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：不在开发模式的服务器每次启动、开始接请求之前，会结束开发种子建的管理员和演示账号在开发期拿到的会话、API key 和令牌，包括这些账号以别人身份开的会话；只针对仍是种子密码的这些账号，运维改过密码的账号和管理员自建的账号不受影响，开发模式下什么都不变。
- 为什么做：开发种子凭据加固的第三项（#34717 裁决里留作跟进的那一项）：离开开发模式后，开发种子签发的东西不再继续起作用。
- 出错会怎样：拿开发库直接上生产的部署，这些账号的旧会话和 key 会失效，需要运维改密后重新登录、重新发 key；结束不干净时服务器拒绝启动并说明是哪些账号。
- 要你做什么：收窄类改动，L1/L2 之后由你合并。

## What changes

**The rule (ruling item 3 on #34717, the card's text): when a deployment leaves development mode, nothing the development seed issued keeps acting for an account that carries the development seed stamp.** Development mode is `NODE_ENV=development` (`isDevelopmentMode`, the predicate the #34717 refusals use). No switch.

From #36311 (unchanged, see that PR for the full account):

- `dev-seed-credential-retirement.ts` (new), `retireDevSeedCredentials`: outside development mode, one indexed read for stamped accounts, the in-force filter (`isDevSeedCredentialInForce`), then per account the revocation `os user set-password` uses (`revokeSessionsAndApiKeys`: sessions tombstoned, keys revoked, authorized apps, device sign-ins, linked sign-in accounts, registered OAuth apps, SCIM credentials), outstanding reset tokens (`endOutstandingResetTokens`), and sessions in a host `secondaryStorage` (read back).
- Wiring: one `kernel:ready` hook in `auth-plugin.ts`, independent of `registerRoutes`; it settles before `kernel:listening` opens the socket.
- Fail closed: anything that does not land fails the boot with one sentence naming the accounts and the remedy.
- Docs (`content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`), changeset (`patch`, `!`, BREAKING section, ADR-0087 `not-required`), census shard regenerated.

New in this PR:

- **The sessions a seed account opened acting as another account are retired too** (`retireSessionsOpenedAs`), tombstoned exactly as the account's own (same reason, counted in `sessions`, same fail-closed rule). A further security item is with the owner seat.
- `forced-reset-revocation.ts`: `isLiveSession` is exported for reuse (no behaviour change).
- Docs and changeset name the new item; the self-hosting sentence about `os user set-password` now says what that command ends (the account's own sessions, keys and grants) instead of "the same credentials".
- Census shard regenerated on current `main` (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`).

**Read first (by risk):**
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-seed-credential-retirement.ts`: `retireDevSeedCredentials` and `retireSessionsOpenedAs`.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`, the `kernel:ready` hook: it runs on every boot outside development.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-seed-credential-retirement.test.ts`, cases 1–3.

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/dev-seed-credential-retirement.test.ts` shows 6 cases green.

## Why

#35184 (p1): credentials the development seed issued kept acting after the deployment left development mode.

## Verification

Branch `claude/project-thread-grxa1f`, head `fb3c2cc478`, on `origin/main` `115d38788e`.

- **Red first.** The new assertion was added to case 1 before the fix and run at the merged head (`035b1fdfe`): case 1 red, 5 others green. After the fix: 6/6 green. Removing the new call is that same red.
- **Suites** (under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`): `dev-seed-credential-retirement`, `dev-seed-credential-production`, `dev-seed-credential` (3 files, 26 passed) on the port before the fix; then `dev-seed-credential-retirement`, `api-key-restore-guard`, `forced-reset-revoke-reason-vocabulary`, `scim-deactivation-reconcile-user`, `session-tombstone`, `admin-impersonate-endpoint` (6 files, 128 passed) after it. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth build && … typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 110, all run: 104 exit 0; `check-empty-changeset` exit 1 by design (the DELIBERATE CORRECTION below); `check-tenant-audit-census` and its self-test exit 1 on the first pass (shard drift from the new write site), regenerated, both re-run exit 0; NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite): `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needs an unshallow clone), `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (need packages built). CI carries those three.
- **Overlap:** see Acceptance notes.
- **Dogfood battery:** not run locally for this round; CI's Dogfood Regression Gate reads it. #36311's battery (484 files passed, 0 failed) was on the code before the new commit.

## Acceptance notes

- **Which accounts.** The in-force reading from #36311 stands: an account whose password was set since the seed holds a credential the seed did not issue and is untouched; retiring on the bare column would end operator-era credentials at every restart.
- **Revoke reason.** `admin_password_reset`, as in #36311; a dedicated reason is follow-up #36313.
- **`.changeset/dev-seed-credential-production-refusal.md`** (unreleased, from #34717) is corrected: see `## DELIBERATE CORRECTION`.
- **Test file weight.** The six two-boot cases read about 11.4 s of test time locally (case 1 gained one sign-in and one request); #36311 read 9.98 s. Over the 10 s file line; splitting the file would duplicate its two-boot harness, so it is kept as one and declared here.
- **Overlap** (`overlap-check.mjs` at this head, #36311 excluded): `.changeset/dev-seed-credential-production-refusal.md` conflicts with #35129; the generated census shard conflicts with #34738 (whoever lands second regenerates it). `auth-plugin.ts` with #36690 merges cleanly.
- The production-readiness page is not edited; the card names the self-hosting checklist.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

This PR rewrites two lines in a pending release note it did not add: `.changeset/dev-seed-credential-production-refusal.md`, in the note's last paragraph. That paragraph's label and its last sentence named the boot-time retirement as a follow-up. This PR ships it, so left unchanged the note would publish two false lines. `check-empty-changeset` stays red by design; the dispatching seat confirms by its own record.

1. The paragraph's bold label
   - Before: "**Not ended at boot:**"
   - After: "**Ended by `os user set-password`, and at boot:**"
2. The paragraph's last sentence
   - Before: "Ending them at boot is follow-up #35184."
   - After: "In the same release, a boot outside development mode also retires them: see the note "a boot outside development mode retires what the development seed issued" (#36699)."
